steps: Register free on Mad Paws and create your sitter profile.
List the services you offer (hosting, sitting, day care, walks, grooming, training) with your own prices.
Complete Mad Paws' sitter vetting (including police background check).
Receive enquiries, do a Meet & Greet, and accept or decline bookings.
Complete the booking; Mad Paws deducts its 20% fee and pays you the rest.
timing: Paid per completed booking via the platform.
